ModMetaData.name: SloppyMods Rimout Power Suit
ModMetaData.author: SloppyMod
ModMetaData.description:
Build 0.9.12
Walking tanks for your colonists. A power suit is a hulking armoured frame that stands on its own until a colonist climbs inside to work and fight in it, and climbs back out when the job is done.
Two suits so far: the Bulwark, a heavy tank, and the Bughunter, built for clearing insect hives - hard to cut, bite or burn. Fit weapon arms to a standing suit - miniguns, rocket pods, lasers, flamers, hammers, a tower shield and more - each suit with arms of its own. Suits run on power cells, recharged at a charging rack, and take a backpack of their own: the Bulwark's shield generator raises a shield when it stands its ground, the Bughunter's jump pack leaps it clear of a swarm, and the Bughunter nets insects in place.
A pilot in a power suit can wield the heavy warcasket weapons from Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates. Unlike a warcasket, nobody is welded in for life.
Works on its own, or - if Exosuit Framework is installed - as an Exosuit Framework suit, with its modules, maintenance bays and repairs, while still standing wherever you leave it.
Early build: the suits, their weapon arms and backpacks, power cells, climbing in and out, and warcasket weapon support. Suit pieces that break off one at a time and more suits are on the way.
Requires Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates.
